suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: derive TypeScript types from TypeBox schemas using Static<typeof Schema> when both exist, rather than manually duplicating interfaces. Example: WorkerHandoff should be `type WorkerHandoff = Static<typeof ReportResultSchema>` rather than a separate interface.
